distinctiveness.read: A strong name to own. VENQORI is coined, arbitrary for water-monitoring software and training, and the whole seven-letter word is the distinctive unit — there is no descriptive part to strip out.
distinctiveness.spectrum: Fanciful — an invented token with no dictionary meaning in any EU language.

per_class.note: Arbitrary for downloadable water-quality monitoring software. No absolute-grounds flag: not descriptive, generic, laudatory, geographic or deceptive for these goods.
Arbitrary for online training services. Same reading; nothing in the mark describes teaching or water compliance.

per_market.market: FR / DE / ES / IT / NL / PL / EL
per_market.note: Reads the same in every relevant market language — nothing makes it descriptive of these goods in any of them.
The transliterated forms Венкори and Βενκόρι are equally coined and equally distinctive; both returned nothing on the register.

counter_registrations.note: The mark's second element stands as a separate live class-9 registration, so rights in that element alone are not the company's to claim.
The nearest whole-word neighbour on the register, and one of three unrelated proprietors of the term inside the instructed classes; a fourth holds it in classes 23, 24 and 25.

distinctiveness.note: The VEN- opening is a crowded brand fragment across the EU class-9 and class-41 register; the strength sits in the whole word, not in either half.

connotation.read: QORI is Quechua for gold, and an Andean word for gold on a water-quality product sits beside a documented Andean gold-mining water-contamination controversy — inside this product's own subject area. Otherwise the meaning sweep came back benign across the languages and scripts searched, with one thin exception: a single community thread debates whether "kori" reads as condescending in Cypriot Greek.

per_market.note: Andean Community Decision 486 bars registration of signs consisting of the names of indigenous, Afro-descendant or local communities. It does not bind EUIPO and is not a registrability question on the instructed register.
Κόρι and Кори read in ordinary Greek as "daughter/girl"; one Reddit thread raises a condescending colloquial use. Thin evidence, and it attaches to the transliteration rather than to the Latin mark.

findings.net: Firepay Merchant Services' live EU registration of qori reaches the company's class-9 software but is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI as a whole.
findings.legal_position: QORI is reproduced identically inside VENQORI and the right is live in the company's core class 9, so an opposition is pleadable on whole-mark incorporation plus class identity. Compared as wholes the marks separate: VENQORI is a single coined seven-letter unit whose dominant opening is VEN-, not a composite of two signs, and the class-9 specification is unread so the reach of the overlap is unestablished.
findings.practical_position: The proprietor trades as Qori, a French merchant-payments brand offering pay-by-bank and crypto-to-fiat acceptance in France, Spain and the UK — a channel and customer set that meets EU water utilities and regulators nowhere. A French business-registry page records a liquidation judiciaire entry and an Estonian regulator's listing shows the cross-border activity licence expired, while the service terms remain published; no registry document for this right was obtained, so its proceedings history is unknown rather than clear.

findings.net: Ridgemount Technologies' VENTURI, registered for bare class 9 in the EU, is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI.
findings.legal_position: This is the closest mark to VENQORI on the EU register — five of seven letters share position and only the medial pair differs — and it sits unrestricted in the company's core class 9, so the goods must be assumed wide until the specification is read. Against that, VENTURI carries an ordinary flow-measurement and surname meaning a coined VENQORI does not, the difference falls where a professional reader's eye rests, and the term is shared: the EU register carries 135 live VENTURI-formative rights, 67 of them in classes 9, 41 and 25, and the exact term inside the instructed classes narrows to three unrelated proprietors (findings 2, 3 and 4). A fourth proprietor, SCHÖFFEL Sportbekleidung, holds VENTURI for yarns, textiles and clothing in classes 23, 24 and 25 — corroboration from a different goods lane, which earns nothing in this one. The fetched document for that fourth right records three oppositions filed against it in 2015, all withdrawn and none naming its opponent: the term has drawn opposition once, in the textile classes, and no enforcer stands behind this right.
findings.practical_position: Ridgemount designs and manufactures fibre-optic connectors, and Venturi is its connector range — a business that meets water utilities and regulators nowhere. That bears on whether this owner would act; it does not read the registration down. No registry document was obtained for this right, so its proceedings history is unknown.

findings.net: Jörg Wollesen's VENTURI is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI in the EU, its class-41 services reading on a register mirror as combine-harvester training.
findings.legal_position: The only VENTURI right landing in instructed class 41 and in class 42, the closest adjacency to the company's own goods, and the mark reads as it does in finding 2. A register mirror reports the specification as agricultural machinery in class 7, workshops and training on the use and maintenance of combine harvesters in class 41, and machine engineering for agricultural equipment in class 42 — combine-harvester operator training and drinking-water compliance certification are different lanes inside one class, on different buyers and channels. The official registry document was not obtained, so that wording is reported rather than read.
findings.practical_position: An individual proprietor with no company, website or trading presence located under the mark; a register mirror is not evidence of use. The right has stood since 2011, and no registry document was obtained for it, so its proceedings history is unknown rather than clear.

findings.net: Gildo-Pierre Pallanca-Pastor's VENTURI is a Monaco electric-vehicle marque and is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI in classes 9 and 42.
findings.legal_position: The mark reads as it does in finding 2 and the same shared-term dilution across the EU classes searched applies. Classes 9 and 42 are present and the specification is unread, so the goods cannot be excluded on the record; the class-12 anchor points the right at vehicles rather than at measurement software.
findings.practical_position: The proprietor owns Venturi, a Monaco electric-vehicle maker with a motorsport and speed-record history — no water-sector, instrumentation or training activity surfaced. The registration is recent, so a non-use challenge would not be open for some years.

findings.net: Qoria Holdings' QORIA covers the company's own classes 9, 41 and 42 in the EU but is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI as a whole.
findings.legal_position: The only QORI-family right live in both instructed classes plus class 42, so the class overlap is complete and the specification is unread. Compared as wholes, VENQORI does not contain QORIA: the shared material sits in the tail while the dominant openings VEN- and QOR- share nothing, leaving class overlap to carry confusion on its own, which it cannot for a tendered, technically-evaluated purchase.
findings.practical_position: Qoria is an operating group selling child online-safety and digital-wellbeing software to schools, with a Europe site, Spanish and UK operations and European school customers. Its class-41 activity is school safeguarding education, not professional operator certification, so its actual trade meets the company's nowhere.

findings.net: Quori Pte. Ltd's QUORI is a risk-analytics brand and is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI in class 9.
findings.legal_position: A straight homophone of the contained QORI element, live in the core class with an unread specification. As wholes the two diverge at the opening, the position a European reader weighs most, and class 41 is absent from the right entirely, leaving the company's training line untouched.
findings.practical_position: Quori sells AI-driven operational-intelligence and risk-management software, listed on Google Play and on a UK public-sector purchasing framework; no EU deployment, office or customer surfaced. Risk analytics and water-quality measurement are bought by different functions through different channels.

owner.name: Asociación Interprofesional de la Carne de Caza (ASICCAZA)

findings.net: ASICCAZA's VENARI is the closest mark to VENQORI in the company's class 41 and is unlikely to prevail against it, its online courses teaching game-meat cookery.
findings.legal_position: By shape one of the closest positions in the band — VEN-A-RI against VEN-QO-RI shares the dominant opening and the ending — and it lands in instructed class 41 with an unread specification. The services separate them: VENARI is an international school of game gastronomy running online courses for chefs, a different shelf, buyer and subject from drinking-water operator certification, and the sign is figurative rather than a bare word.
findings.practical_position: A Spanish game-meat interprofessional association running a training centre at Almagro with an online platform in Spanish and English, certificates and in-person masterclasses. Its customers are chefs, hunters and food-sector professionals, and nothing places it near utilities, regulators or process-water operators.

findings.net: Shenzhen Dongfang Qingsen's pending VENTORIX confers no rights yet and is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI in classes 9 and 11.
findings.legal_position: The sign carries VENTORI, one substitution from the applied-for mark, and pairs class 9 with class 11 — treatment hardware extending into monitoring software is an ordinary line extension in this sector. The terminal -X and the differing medial letters break the whole-mark comparison, and a published application confers no right until registration.
findings.practical_position: No product, catalogue, trading presence or water-treatment offering under VENTORIX surfaced, and the proprietor's exact legal identity could not be confirmed among several similarly named Shenzhen companies. The application is in examination, so the specification may still narrow.

findings.net: WIREMIND's EVENTORI is a sports-ticketing platform and is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI across the company's classes.
findings.legal_position: The broadest in-scope class profile in the band — both instructed classes plus 35 and 42 — and the sign contains VENTORI, with the specification unread. As wholes the initial E and the ordinary EVENT- reading give the mark a conceptual anchor VENQORI does not share, so the marks separate on the element a buyer actually reads.
findings.practical_position: EVENTORI is WIREMIND's ticketing and revenue-management SaaS for professional sports clubs and event organisers, in active use with growing club deployments. Stadium ticketing analytics and water-compliance measurement meet nowhere in the market.

findings.net: The unregistered VENTURI used at venturi.io for IoT asset monitoring has no established EU trade and is unlikely to prevail against VENQORI.
findings.legal_position: The one place a VENTURI-formative name is actually used for monitoring, and the manifest's named high-salience form neighbour, so mark similarity is high. An unregistered sign is enforceable only on its actual trade, and that trade is remote asset, fleet, facility and plant telematics — pumps, generators, HVAC, fluid levels and video — with no water-quality or environmental-compliance offering marketed anywhere on the site.
findings.practical_position: No EU trading presence, reseller or regional entity was established, and the operating company behind the domain could not be confirmed, so an EU claim would rest on goodwill this run did not find. Industrial IoT is a sector the matter frame flags as converging on utility telemetry, which is why the name is carried rather than dropped.

findings.net: NXP's QORIQ covers communications processors sold to hardware engineers and does not reach the company's water-monitoring software.
findings.legal_position: The sign contains QORI but is a five-letter processor-family name, and QorIQ is NXP's communications-processor portfolio for networking, telecommunications and industrial equipment. Silicon sold to hardware and systems engineers and downloadable water-quality monitoring software are different goods bought by different people, so the class-9 number is all the two rights share.
findings.practical_position: NXP is a large class-9 proprietor with the portfolio and practice to watch and oppose filings, which is why the right is worth a lawyer's line. Nothing in the material read shows any assertion of QORIQ against an applications-software filer, and demand letters and settlements are private and reach no search.

findings.net: Siemens Healthineers' ORI is a three-letter sign too remote from VENQORI as a whole to found a claim against it.
findings.legal_position: A bare three-letter sign against a seven-letter coined word shares only a terminal string and no dominant opening, so no confusion pathway arises whatever the class list says. The right is live in both instructed classes, which is the only reason it is mentioned at all.
findings.practical_position: The proprietor is a medical imaging and in-vitro diagnostics business selling to hospitals and clinical laboratories; a search could not establish what product, if any, is sold under ORI. It sits on this matter's own incumbent watchlist as a large proprietor, which is why it is worth knowing.

context_notes.context: Carried for diligence because BENQ is a well-known class-9 name sitting inside the manifest's phonetic variant BENQORI. No BENQ-family right entered the register band and no BENQORI listing surfaced on any searched platform; no record was fetched for it, so it is noted rather than treated as a conflict.

third_party_rights.read: No one owns VENQORI on the EU register in the searched classes. The rights that exist are neighbours of its parts — the contained element QORI and the VEN- opening — and none of them is strong.
third_party_rights.basis: The exact slice, the formative root and the full variant band enumerated to zero in classes 9 and 41; the rated conflicts are element neighbours, four of them sharing a term held by three unrelated proprietors in the instructed classes.

objection_likelihood.read: An objection cannot be excluded but none looks likely. Firepay Merchant Services is the one owner with a straight ground to plead against a bare class-9 filing.
objection_likelihood.basis: Owner-by-owner reads on the rated conflicts: every proprietor's actual business sits outside water compliance, and no assertion by any of them surfaced.

registrability.read: VENQORI faces no absolute-grounds objection at EUIPO — it is coined and arbitrary for these goods. The exposure is the citation landscape, and the register carries unrestricted class-9 "computer software" and class-41 internet-course terms that the company's own wording has to live beside.

obstacles.note: A live registration of QORI, the mark's own second element, stands unrestricted in this class, alongside the closest whole-word neighbour VENTURI.
VENTURI and VENARI are both live here, and third-party rights recite teaching and internet courses without restriction.

registrability.basis: The absolute-grounds read on the applicant's own mark, plus the class-9 and class-41 rights carried as findings and the unrestricted specifications read at the screen gate.

client_enforceability.read: A coined seven-letter word with no register neighbour of the whole term should enforce well across classes 9 and 41. Rights in its parts would be narrow — QORI and VEN- are each shared with other owners.
client_enforceability.basis: The mark's fanciful placement on the distinctiveness spectrum against the element crowd: the VEN- opening is a heavily used brand fragment in the EU class-9 and class-41 register, and QORI stands separately registered.

actions.text: Narrow the class-9 wording to downloadable water-quality monitoring software rather than filing for computer software at large.

ask_answers.answer: You asked: "EU register only." → Satisfied. Every record in the band is an EUTM or an International registration designating the EU, every dictated slice ran against EUIPO in region EU, and no record from an excluded territory entered the band. One qualification: this was read as the EU-wide register at EUIPO including IRs designating the EU, so the 27 national member-state registers were not searched — a national-only right would not have surfaced.

ask_answers.ask: Nothing outside the EU is in scope for this example.
ask_answers.answer: You asked: "Nothing outside the EU is in scope for this example." → Honoured. Nothing outside the EU is cited as a conflict. Owner domicile abroad is not a foreign right: the Australian, Singaporean, Chinese and Monegasque proprietors listed hold EUTMs or IRs effective in the EU. Two non-EU items surfaced and are excluded — Vencore Inc., a US contractor, and a VENQOR keychain listing on an Indian marketplace. One item sits on the line and is disclosed rather than dropped: the unregistered VENTURI at venturi.io is a web presence reachable from the EU with no established EU trade, carried as finding 10 on that footing.
